project.description:
The Vulkan-bearing half of the technique SPI: VulkanTechniqueContext, the subtype a technique casts its TechniqueContext to when it must create GPU objects (docs/refactor-decisions.md D3, D18).
It exists so that a technique module does not compile against the runtime *implementation*. Before it, vexelray-technique-sdf and vexelray-technique-canvas both depended on vexelray-engine — the concrete Vulkan engine, its frame loop and its window — to reach one accessor, which coupled every technique to one runtime and pointed the dependency arrow the wrong way: the runtime should depend on what techniques are written against, not the reverse. This module is that contract and nothing else.
